name: isiXhosa
notes: Broad phonemic transcription that keeps every contrast the spelling writes. Built from the CLDR xh-xh_FONIPA transform (written against the NCHLT-inlang isiXhosa dictionary), orthography2ipa xh.json and Epitran xho-Latn.csv, with the consonant table of the Wikipedia article on Xhosa.
Plain p t k ts tl ty kr are ejective in careful speech; the ejective mark is left out because the spelling predicts it, and the aspirated series carries ʰ.
Clicks are written without their velar accompaniment: c ǀ, ch ǀʰ, gc ɡǀ, nc ŋǀ, ngc ŋɡǀ, nkc ŋkǀ, and the same for q (ǃ) and x (ǁ).
The breathy-voiced (depressor) nasals mh nh nyh ngh are written with ɦ (mɦ ...), which is in the default id map, instead of the breathy diacritic, which is not.

Tone is not written in Xhosa and is not transcribed. Mid vowels are written ɛ ɔ as in the NCHLT dictionary; their raising to e o before i u, and penultimate lengthening, are left for the voice to learn.

rules.note: Velar nasal before velars and clicks: ng ŋɡ, nk ŋk, nc ŋǀ, ngc ŋɡǀ, nkc ŋkǀ. A rule rather than digraphs so that n+kh, n+ch stay ŋkʰ, ŋǀʰ.
Ejective after a nasal (intshaba), aspirated elsewhere (tshisa), as in the CLDR transform and the NCHLT dictionary.
